p.span:
Selection criteria:
EFA: KMO ≥ 0.50, Bartlett p<0.05, factor loading ≥ 0.40, oblimin rotation.
IRT: discrimination a ≥ 0.50 (2PL dichotomous, GRM polytomous).
LCA: BIC minimum, entropy ≥ 0.80, minimum class size ≥ 5% of the sample.
Performance anchor: average of 30 Plausible Values (Math + Reading + Science) PISA 2022.
